title: Real-time WebSocket full-duplex market connectors
summary: Both venue connectors were extended from REST-only (ccxt) to full-duplex WebSocket streaming with incremental orderbook maintenance, CRC32 checksum verification, sequence-gap REST resync, and bounded exponential-backoff reconnection.

components.name: OrderbookMaintenance
components.purpose: Incremental L2 book with bounded depth, zero-amount deletion, CRC32 checksum computation

components.name: WebSocketStreamSession
components.purpose: Full-duplex session: concurrent read pump with outbound send, capped exponential backoff reconnect with jitter, automatic resubscribe

components.name: LatencySamples
components.purpose: Bounded ring buffer producing p50/p95/p99 quantiles without unbounded growth

components.name: ResyncRequest
components.purpose: Auditable record of every automatic REST snapshot recovery

defects_found_and_repaired.description: Kraken v2 signals snapshot vs update at the FRAME level (msg['type']), not per data entry. The initial parser read entry['type'], so every live frame fell through and zero books were built despite 100+ frames received.
defects_found_and_repaired.evidence: Live trace showed recv=136 messages with books empty; frame inspection showed type at top level.

defects_found_and_repaired.description: Kraken v2 emits levels as objects {'price':..,'qty':..}, not [price,qty] pairs. Every level was silently dropped.
Coinbase places product_id on the event object, not on update rows, so symbol resolution returned None and no book was published.

Live Kraken CRC32 checksums do not reproduce under the documented algorithm. Verified against multiple format variants and against ccxt's own reference implementation (ccxt/pro/kraken.py), which also fails and which disables the check by default with the comment 'the exchange checksum was not reliable'.
defects_found_and_repaired.resolution: Verification always runs and mismatches are always counted as diagnostics. Escalation to REST resync is opt-in via strict_checksum=True, defaulting to False to prevent a continuous resync storm against an unreliable venue value.

defects_found_and_repaired.description: websockets resolved from an external Python 3.14 site-packages via a leaked PYTHONPATH rather than the project venv, masking a missing dependency.
defects_found_and_repaired.fix: Installed websockets into .venv and declared it in pyproject.toml dependencies; scripts/verify.py now strips inherited PYTHONPATH from gate subprocesses

defects_found_and_repaired.description: A delta arriving before any snapshot left the book empty with no recovery path.
defects_found_and_repaired.fix: missing_snapshot resync triggers a REST snapshot
